messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — we're planning a coordinated launch for the "MicroAdapter" reference app: tutorial, OSS launch post, short benchmark narrative, and a 30-minute live demo/webinar. Goal: dev audiences + inbound lead capture. Tentative date: 2026-05-12.
Sam: Love it. Can we make the tutorial focused on a real integration (e.g., proxying requests to Redwood Dedicated + local cache)? Short 20-min walkthrough + repo link.
Omar: I can surface perf numbers for the adapter. Will run a throughput/latency bench with quantized model + caching by EOD Wed. Need config & sample dataset — can someone drop that?
Jen: I'll mock up hero screens and a 2-slide webinar banner. Want a terminal + small UI shot. Which repo should I screenshot?
Sophie: For inbound, let's pair a lightweight gated asset (1-page checklist) with a form that maps to MQL tags: "refapp-demo-webinar" + source=marketing-web. Can Growth own the form logic?
Maya: @Sophie yes, Growth can own the form. Sam — can you add a tiny sample dataset to the repo under /examples so Jen has realistic UI to screenshot?
Sam: Yep. I'll add a minimal dataset and sample curl in README. Also adding a quickstart snippet:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"micro-q4", "input":"summary: ..."}'
```
Omar: Bench plan: 3 configs — (1) no cache single-thread, (2) cache enabled, (3) batching enabled. I'll include cost-per-1k-tokens estimates and a short blurb on tradeoffs.
Jen: Screenshot schedule: need final repo by Fri so I can design by Monday. Also request component — can we show the lead form modal in the UI comp?
Maya: Yes, include modal. Also want 2 short social captions: (a) launch post with benchmark callout, (b) tutorial CTA. Sophie please draft.
Sophie: Drafting now. Quick question: tone — technical but approachable, with callouts for infra teams. Use hashtag #RedwoodRefApps?
Maya: That's fine. Keep CTAs: "Try the MicroAdapter refapp" and "Join 30-min live demo". Add webinar RSVP link once form ready.
dev-bot: Reminder: set up UTM tracking for campaign links and ensure tracking param utm_campaign=microadapter_launch
Sam: One open issue — license for bundled sample data. I'll keep it CC0 and note it in README.
Omar: I'll push bench results as CSV to /benchmarks and short markdown summary in /docs/bench.md.
Jen: I'll post final hero and a short alt-text for accessibility.
Maya: Action items recap:
- Sam: sample data + README snippet + repo PR by Thu
- Omar: bench runs + CSV + bench.md by Wed EOD
- Jen: hero + modal comps by Mon
- Sophie: social copy + gated asset draft by Fri
- Growth: form + UTM mapping
I'll stitch the launch post and set publish date once assets in. Thanks :sparkles:
Sophie: I'll set up a simple leaderboard email segment for attendees and non-attendees.
Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/microadapter/pull/42 — includes dataset and quickstart. PTAL.
Maya: Great — moving to a short checklist doc. Anyone wants to add notes, reply here. :rocket:
